explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1025: g(n)≍n^{1/2} from Spencer's lower bound and Conlon-Fox-Sudakov's upper bound. g is the largest k such that each valid f has an independent X with |X|≥k, with f(x,y)∉{x,y} and independence tested on distinct pairs. The k≤n bound keeps sSup real when no valid f exists at small n, which does not affect the asymptotic.
